requirements.duty: The complete native module has eight byte lanes and no parameters. nvdla_core_clk,nvdla_hls_clk and nvdla_core_ng_clk are tied to the same free-running clock in this benchmark. Active-low nvdla_core_rstn asynchronously clears configuration,operation history,metadata pipelines,clock-enable history,flush counter and registered native outputs. Reset during traffic restarts the entire8192-address flush. Raw operand and arithmetic storage need not reset; their contents cannot establish a valid converted result before its input history. Release reset away from rising edges. All native outputs,including invalid address/data,are checked with exact four-state semantics.
requirements.legal_history: Tie all three native clocks together; use binary inputs stable around edges,asynchronous active-low reset,mutually exclusive source enables and info low nibble0001 for transactions. Drain12clocks before any configuration change and hold each captured configuration through its traffic. Assert startup and midtraffic resets in bypass and conversion modes,including after a partly completed flush. Observe immediate output clearing and complete post-reset flush restart.

requirements.duty: Define active_next=reg2dp_op_en AND NOT dp2reg_done. At each rising edge active stores active_next. Only active_next1 with old active0 captures cvt_en,proc_precision,truncate,offset,scale and pad_value. Continuing active cycles retain configuration. done1 clears active even when op_en remains1,so a later done0 edge with op_en1 captures a new operation. Input precision and nan_to_zero have no functional data effect in this fixed integer-byte implementation. Keep configuration stable while that operation input/arithmetic pipeline is in flight,and drain at least12clocks before reconfiguration.

requirements.duty: There is no ready input: every dc2cvt_dat_wr_en or img2cvt_dat_wr_en assertion accepts that64-bit payload and17-bit address. Legal functional transactions assert at most one source enable and set info[3:0]=4'b0001. info[7] chooses per-lane mean subtraction and info[8] chooses unsigned byte input; bits11:9 and6:4 are neutral. Consecutive input transactions,source alternation and idle gaps are legal. Image padding uses its eight-bit mask; direct-source transactions have no padding. The bypass path produces registered output data and normal transaction enable/address one clock after acceptance; conversion produces them five clocks after acceptance. During startup flush the normal address/enable is overridden by the flush obligation.

requirements.duty: Apply captured six-bit truncate to each signed34-bit product: shift0 preserves it; shifts1..33 divide by2^shift with rounding to nearest integer and exact half ties away from zero; shifts34..63 yield zero. Saturate this result to signed17-bit range[-65536,65535]. Then captured proc_precision1 saturates to signed16-bit range[-32768,32767]; every other two-bit code saturates to signed8-bit range[-128,127]. The top-level packed byte is the low8bits of that final signed value,including precision1 results. Arithmetic is evaluated before image padding.

requirements.duty: A14-bit flush counter starts0 on reset and increments each released edge until bit13 becomes1 at8192,then holds. While its pre-edge bit13=0,the registered write enable is1 and address is that pre-edge counter value0..8191. The edge writing address8191 also makes dp2reg_dat_flush_done1. On later edges normal delayed transaction-valid controls enable and updates address only when valid; otherwise address holds. Flush has unconditional address/enable priority over input traffic. Flush does not force data to zero: data continues the documented retained bypass/conversion/padding path. The done output stays1 until reset.
